summary.headline: Stephanos’ Astrological Treatise
summary.text: Subscription by Eleutherios in Mytilene, followed by a catalog of Stephanos of Alexandria’s astrological treatise to Timotheos and excerpts on zodiac signs, planetary rulership, decans, overcoming, likeness, spear-bearing, conjunctions and full moons, city foundations, and zodiac quadrants, with references to Hephaestion and Florentine codices.
